purpose: Five preview concepts; no application icons replaced

prompts.title: 01 / MONOLİT
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally art-directed high-resolution landscape presentation board for a bespoke icon family for Turkish structural engineering AutoCAD utility palette called YARDIMCI. This is a premium design concept image, not a web dashboard. Sophisticated international design-award submission quality, coherent iconic silhouettes, extremely polished optical balance, generous editorial spacing. Avoid stock icon library appearance, generic app logos, random abstract symbols, illegible microtext, excessive ornamental detail. The engineering function must remain recognizable. Show exactly 12 large distinct icons in an immaculate 4-column x 3-row grid on the left two thirds, each with its short Turkish caption below, in this order: 'Oto Ölçü' dimension line with end ticks; 'Plan Ölçü' dimensioned floorplan corner; 'Merdiven' stairs; 'Döşeme Donatı' concrete slab with parallel reinforcing bars; 'Sehpa Donatısı' bent steel rebar support chair silhouette; 'Hasır Donatı' welded wire square mesh; 'Temel Detayı' T-shaped foundation section; 'Kuranglez' exterior U-shaped basement lightwell with side wall; 'Perde Boşluk' concrete wall with clearly rectangular central opening and reinforcement around it; 'Donatı Boyu' hooked rebar with length dimension; 'Donatı Metraj' measurement/calculation sheet with rebar mark; 'Kot Değiştir' elevation datum triangle and vertical arrow. Right third: realistic slim dark charcoal desktop tool palette headed 'YARDIMCI', containing the SAME twelve icons miniaturized at consistent small UI size next to those same readable Turkish labels. Large icons and small panel icons must match. Practical pictograms: avoid intricate scenes or buildings for everything. Clear difference between Kuranglez and Perde Boşluk. Caption typography refined professional sans serif. Title at top left specified below, a small 'SİMGE TASARIMI / KONSEPT' subtitle. Small '32 px' caption by compact panel. Do not claim any award has been won. No designer attribution. No watermark.
Title text verbatim: '01 / MONOLİT'.
Visual direction: Sculptural architectural isometric miniature icons. Rounded precision-machined solid concrete and anodized aluminium bodies, warm ivory structural sections, vivid cobalt blue and safety-orange rebar accents, tiny restrained contact shadows. Dark midnight charcoal overall board, warm white text. Each icon a strong compact volumetric engineering object with 2 to 4 components and beautifully controlled 30 degree isometric view. Rebar physically bent, structural openings convincing. Premium industrial product rendering meets expertly crafted operating-system icon family. Colorful but disciplined. No enclosing app tiles; silhouettes breathe.

Title text verbatim: '02 / RİTİM'.
Visual direction: Radically flat bold geometric vector-style pictograms, playful intellectual precision, richly colored Bauhaus-adjacent contemporary Swiss visual identity without imitating a named designer. Warm ivory board, charcoal text, striking vermilion, ultramarine, jade and golden-yellow limited palette distributed coherently by function. Chunky monoline and solid geometric shapes combined, smart negative space, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows. Icons have ingenious distinctive silhouettes, engineering functions distilled into two or three interlocking shapes. Palette UI still dark charcoal, high legibility. This concept should feel like a celebrated museum identity adapted to a serious engineering tool.

Title text verbatim: '04 / ATÖLYE'.
Visual direction: Premium industrial enamel signage icon system. Deep petrol board, warm cream typography. Icons built from bold functional cutout silhouettes in warm ivory, safety orange and muted aqua, set within consistently rounded dark metal square tiles with an extremely subtle enamel surface and thin machined bevel. Almost flat frontal view, not isometric. Authentic instrument-panel sophistication, distinctive robust engineering symbols with exceptionally clear negative space. No distressed texture, no retro kitsch, no screws around every tile, no yellow-black hazard stripes. Restrained tactile craftsmanship, high-end workshop instrumentation, strong small-size usability. Icon object itself is more important than tile.

Title text verbatim: '05 / KATMAN'.
Visual direction: Masterful precision-cut layered paper and folded matte polymer icon family. Light warm stone board, graphite typography. Rich coral, deep teal, cornflower blue and warm marigold accents with creamy-white foundations. Crisp parallel layered edges express concrete and rebar, gentle tactile paper relief and soft short contact shadows, very clean geometric isometric/front hybrid view consistent across all icons. Clever folds form stairs, rebar chair, footing section and wall opening; not generic sheets of paper for every function. Modern collectible architectural maquettes, confident colorful artistry without childish cartoons. No enclosing square tiles, no busy decorative textures.
